title: Claim Registry
description: Schema for the religion-knowledge project claim-level fact-check ledger. Each entry records one factual or interpretive claim, its source support, confidence, and review status.

claim_id.description: Stable unique ID for this claim. Format: PREFIX-TOPIC-NNN, e.g. HF-EXILE-001, TR-ALMAH-001.

claim_text.description: Exact wording of the claim as it appears (or should appear) in the public document. Do not paraphrase.

claim_type.description: Classification of the claim. Determines the evidence standard required.

status.description: Current audit verdict for this claim.

confidence.description: Evidential confidence level, independent of status.

primary_sources.description: Primary texts, manuscripts, inscriptions, or archaeological evidence directly supporting or relevant to this claim.

locator.description: Page, section, verse, line, or URL

secondary_sources.description: Scholarly secondary literature. Each entry records author, title, locator, and stance.

citation.description: Full bibliographic citation: Author, Title, Publisher, Year.

counterargument.description: Strongest serious competing interpretation or objection. Required for status=disputed or claim_type=ethical_polemical.

prohibited_wording_exception.description: If this claim uses high-certainty language (proves, all scholars agree, clearly means, etc.), explain here why it is justified for this specific claim.

last_verified.description: ISO 8601 date of last independent verification, e.g. 2026-09-26.

reviewer.description: Name or role of the person who last verified this claim.

public_locations.description: Every public-facing document and anchor where this claim appears.

notes.description: Free-text notes, correction history, or context not captured by other fields.
